llm.summary: This skill is mostly coherent for managing Mistral AI through OOMOL, but it includes high-impact Mistral actions and unsafe first-time installer commands that deserve manual review.

dimensions.detail: The skill's purpose matches its capabilities: it operates Mistral AI via the OOMOL `mistral_ai` connector and discloses read, write, upload, sharing, and delete actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad, but the runtime instructions list actions and require confirmation for write actions and explicit approval for destructive actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: First-time setup tells the agent to install the `oo` CLI using remote scripts piped directly into shell or PowerShell, without checksum/signature verification or explicit user approval before installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The requested authority is limited to `Bash(oo *)` for operating the OOMOL connector, but the connector can affect Mistral account resources including agents, files, libraries, shares, and conversations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill relies on an existing OOMOL account connection with server-side credential injection and does not expose raw tokens or add background persistence, but changes made through Mistral AI may persist in the connected account.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent operate your Mistral AI account through OOMOL. Review every write, upload, sharing, or delete request before approving it, and install the `oo` CLI manually from trusted documentation with verification rather than letting the skill run pipe-to-shell installer commands.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad Mistral routing is purpose-related and partially mitigated by action tags plus confirmation rules, so it is a scoping note rather than evidence of deception.
[SC2] unexpected: Installing the connector CLI is setup-related, but executing unverified remote installer scripts is not a proportionate default for an agent-run fallback.
